avoid_supplements.name: Aluminum-containing antacids
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Aluminum hydroxide significantly reduces didanosine absorption by buffering gastric pH and forming complexes
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; separate administration by at least 2 hours

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium-containing antacids
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Magnesium compounds reduce didanosine bioavailability through pH elevation and chelation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; separate administration by at least 2 hours

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Calcium reduces didanosine absorption through pH-dependent and chelation mechanisms
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor viral load

avoid_supplements.name: Itraconazole
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Itraconazole requires acidic pH for absorption; didanosine buffering agents reduce both drug levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; use alternative antifungal if possible

avoid_supplements.name: Ketoconazole
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Ketoconazole absorption is pH-dependent; significant reduction in both drug concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; consider alternatives or separate dosing by 2+ hours

caution_supplements.name: Sodium bicarbonate
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild pH elevation may reduce didanosine absorption to a lesser extent than aluminum/magnesium
caution_supplements.action: Monitor viral load; separate dosing by 2+ hours if concurrent use necessary

caution_supplements.name: Multivitamins with minerals
caution_supplements.mechanism: Metal cations (Ca, Mg, Fe, Zn) may reduce didanosine bioavailability
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by 2+ hours; consider mineral-free formulations

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Fat delays gastric emptying and reduces didanosine absorption by 50% or more
avoid_foods.action: Administer on empty stomach; take 30 minutes before or 2 hours after food

caution_foods.name: Dairy products
caution_foods.mechanism: Calcium content may marginally reduce didanosine bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Space dairy intake 2+ hours from didanosine dose when possible

caution_foods.name: Iron-fortified cereals and foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Iron may chelate didanosine and reduce absorption
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent timing; monitor for virologic response

monitoring_notes: Didanosine requires strict adherence to empty stomach dosing and separation from divalent cations to maintain adequate plasma concentrations for viral suppression. Monitor HIV viral load and CD4 count regularly, as subtherapeutic levels due to absorption interactions may lead to resistance development.
